products.name: Sunglasses
products.description: Aviator shades for people who say "let's take this offline" and then never do. Polarized against harsh light and harsher feedback.

products.name: Tank Top
products.description: A cropped cotton tank with a scooped neckline and the quiet confidence of someone who already stretched.

products.name: Watch
products.description: Gold-tone stainless steel that tells the time and, if you stare long enough, how long this meeting has been going.

products.name: Loafers
products.description: Summer loafers that look like you have somewhere better to be, even if that place is the couch.

products.name: Hairdryer
products.description: Three heat settings, one speed called "I have seven minutes," and a cord long enough to reach your excuses.

products.name: Candle Holder
products.description: A small, intricate holder for candles, dramatic lighting, and the one personality trait you are willing to discuss.

products.name: Salt and Pepper Shakers
products.description: A matched pair that seasons dinner and, frankly, most opinions. Dishwasher safe. Drama not included.

products.name: Bamboo Glass Jar
products.description: Holds 57 oz of pasta, coffee, or the snacks you told yourself were "for guests."

products.name: Mustard Mug
products.description: A simple mug with a mustard interior. Looks cheerful. Holds the coffee that is doing the actual work.

products.name: Emergency Meeting Hoodie
products.description: Soft fleece for calls that could have been an email. The hood is for focus. The pocket is for snacks you will deny later.

products.name: Desk Plant That Judges You
products.description: A low-maintenance plant with a high-maintenance stare. Water it when you remember your own lunch.

products.name: Noise-Cancelling Headphones
products.description: Cancels the open office, the dishwasher, and at least one opinion from across the table. Battery lasts longer than most resolutions.

products.name: Laptop Sticker Pack
products.description: Twelve stickers that imply you have read the documentation. We will not check. Your laptop will look faster. It will not be.

products.name: Questionable Decisions Thermos
products.description: Keeps coffee hot through the decision you will explain tomorrow. Leakproof lid. Leakier judgment sold separately.

products.name: I Read the Docs Tote
products.description: Heavy canvas, roomy enough for a laptop, a paperback, and the lie that you finished the changelog.

products.name: Allegedly Matching Socks
products.description: A pair that left the warehouse together. What happens in the laundry is between you and the dryer.

products.name: Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: Clicky keys for people who want the whole room to know they are typing. Includes a volume of confidence and zero volume control.

products.name: Desk Lamp Named Greg
products.description: Warm light, brass neck, and a name tag because every desk needs one coworker who does not schedule meetings.

products.name: Excuse-Tracking Bottle
products.description: A 24 oz bottle with time markers: sip, stretch, invent a reason to leave the chat. BPA-free. Excuse-rich.

products.name: Indoor Weather Beanie
products.description: For apartments that treat 68 degrees like a personality. Ribbed knit. Works with headphones. Works with denial.

products.name: Half-Finished Notebook
products.description: 192 pages, dotted grid, and a cover sturdy enough for the side project you will reopen in March.

products.name: Decorative Snack Lock
products.description: A charming latch for the drawer everyone knows about. It will not stop you. It will make you feel seen.

products.name: Weekend Backpack
products.description: Fits a change of clothes, a book you will not open, and the charger you will definitely forget.

products.name: Slippers With Ambition
products.description: House slippers that look presentable enough for the porch, the package pickup, and one accidental video call.

products.name: Second Coffee Mug
products.description: For the refill that becomes the plan. Wide rim, honest handle, and room for foam you will photograph once.
